text: My daily routine is quite simple, and I try to follow it every day. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I go to work and stay at the office until five in the afternoon. When I get home, I like to exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or doing yoga. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch some TV, or read a book. I always go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent helps me feel organized, healthy, and ready for the next day.
